context_factor: US National Diabetes Mellitus Research and Education Act; coordinated NIH centers/commission/data infrastructure
effect_on_timing_or_adoption: Likely accelerated research coordination and standardization; direct causal contribution to the T1/T2 biological distinction not demonstrated
scientific_validity_role: Context only; biological validity rests on disease evidence

context_factor: Mount Sinai clinic/pathology infrastructure; evolving endoscopy/pathology; Great Depression period
effect_on_timing_or_adoption: Institutional/technical capacity plausibly enabled recognition; economic effect is unproven
scientific_validity_role: Do not use Depression-era timing as scientific evidence

context_factor: World War II military hepatitis burden and yellow-fever-vaccine outbreak
effect_on_timing_or_adoption: Accelerated focused studies; military investigators helped define two forms before viruses were isolated
scientific_validity_role: Strong context effect on timing but not on validity of distinct viruses

context_factor: Chinese Cultural Revolution; constrained scientific careers; later China-France collaboration
effect_on_timing_or_adoption: Political disruption delayed/suppressed research and recognition; later collaboration accelerated replication and international adoption
scientific_validity_role: Valid split despite adverse context; context explains recognition delay

context_factor: NCI funding; biotechnology/Genentech; companion diagnostics; FDA; DOD breast-cancer funding/advocacy
effect_on_timing_or_adoption: Accelerated biomarker-to-drug translation and adoption
scientific_validity_role: Does not substitute for HER2 biology and treatment interaction

context_factor: Transcriptomics/omics; large cohorts; biologic drug development and market/access structures
effect_on_timing_or_adoption: Enabled endotype discovery and treatment; may create research asymmetry between T2-high and T2-low
scientific_validity_role: Context can shape which endotype is studied; marker/pathway validity remains scientific

context_factor: International expert committee; clinical-trial recruitment; regulator/sponsor adoption
effect_on_timing_or_adoption: Formal phenotype definitions were explicitly created for communication/prognosis/trials and later regulatory use
scientific_validity_role: Operational utility can validate a stage descriptor without proving separate disease biology

context_factor: Long DSM/ICD institutional persistence despite declining scientific use
effect_on_timing_or_adoption: Administrative tradition helped maintain subtypes after weak scientific utility became apparent
scientific_validity_role: Contextual persistence must not be mistaken for validation

context_factor: Chromosome-preparation/banding, recombinant DNA and targeted-drug technologies; broad cancer-research expansion
effect_on_timing_or_adoption: Technology made the discriminator observable and later targetable
scientific_validity_role: Technology availability controls discovery timing; causal lesion validates entity

context_factor: Molecular pathology; targeted-drug platform; orphan-drug/regulatory pathway
effect_on_timing_or_adoption: Rapidly translated KIT biology into GIST-specific therapy and regulatory recognition
scientific_validity_role: Regulatory acceleration follows rather than establishes biological identity

context_factor: Generally available endoscopy/staining/culture; prevailing stress/lifestyle dogma
effect_on_timing_or_adoption: Recognition barrier was largely conceptual/scientific rather than absence of expensive new technology
scientific_validity_role: Dogma can delay valid reclassification; historical consensus is not evidence

context_factor: Global AIDS emergency and international virology networks; West-African geographic concentration
effect_on_timing_or_adoption: Likely facilitated rapid identification after HIV-1; geography shaped detection
scientific_validity_role: Distinct genome/biology, not epidemic attention, establishes HIV-2

context_factor: ILAE consensus task force; patient-care/research standardization need
effect_on_timing_or_adoption: Created a reproducible operational treatment-state definition
scientific_validity_role: Consensus is useful but does not imply one biological disease

context_factor: Antibiotic programs, adherence, drug quality/supply, crowded settings, WHO surveillance
effect_on_timing_or_adoption: Health-system conditions can create acquired resistance and determine detection; surveillance standardized global recognition
scientific_validity_role: Here context can be part of causation of the resistance state, while microbiological testing establishes it

context_factor: Evolution of androgen-deprivation and later hormonal therapies; changing mechanistic knowledge
effect_on_timing_or_adoption: Treatment itself creates/selects the state; new biology forced nomenclature revision
scientific_validity_role: State validity requires treatment/time context and cannot be judged like a pretreatment distinct disease

context_factor: Development of chemotherapy/radiotherapy and clinical-trial infrastructure
effect_on_timing_or_adoption: Reinforced practical importance of SCLC/NSCLC separation
scientific_validity_role: Distinct pathology/natural history plus treatment response support split

context_factor: RAAS physiology, spironolactone, biochemical assays, adrenal venous sampling and imaging
effect_on_timing_or_adoption: Expanded ability to detect/localize a causal form of hypertension
scientific_validity_role: Technology controls detection; autonomous aldosterone biology validates subtype

context_factor: University competition and Kraepelin's authority
effect_on_timing_or_adoption: Helped create/persist presenile-senile split despite weak basis
scientific_validity_role: Context explains a false/unstable split and is a key negative control

context_factor: DSM nosology goals; reliability/specificity; service-eligibility implications
effect_on_timing_or_adoption: Influenced merger and consequences of category change
scientific_validity_role: Policy effects require sensitivity analysis but do not determine biology

context_factor: New renin assays; sodium balance/posture/population/assay characteristics
effect_on_timing_or_adoption: Technology created the candidate subgroup, while measurement context undermined a clean categorical boundary
scientific_validity_role: Measurement dependence is evidence against a single robust disease split

context_factor: Pathology consensus and need for reproducible terminology
effect_on_timing_or_adoption: Simplification followed inconsistent criteria and poor reproducibility
scientific_validity_role: Reproducibility failure is scientific; consensus implemented the correction
